Endpoint: GET /login?next=/dashboard
Target parameter(s): next
Recon evidence: The 302 Location header mirrors the next parameter verbatim.
Planner's rationale: Baseline absolute-URL redirect.

{"vuln_class": "open_redirect", "target_param": "next", "payload": "https://evil.example", "injection_point": "query", "expected_success_signal": "302 with Location: https://evil.example", "confidence": 0.95, "reasoning": "With no validation at all, the absolute attacker URL is copied straight into Location — the baseline against which every filter variant is tested."}
